evals.prompt: Before we add session revocation to our Flask + Postgres app, research the topic. Intent class is MID_SIZED. Run directory: .arianna/2026-05-11-session-revoke/ (the coordinator already created this per-run directory; write every output inside it). The goal: end a user's session on device B from device A within 5 seconds. Dispatch parallel research teammates — external best practice, codebase prior art, and quality commands. Write .arianna/2026-05-11-session-revoke/research.md with the standard schema. Assume the codebase has src/auth/, tests/auth/, a Makefile, and a package.json with scripts.
evals.expected_output: A .arianna/2026-05-11-session-revoke/research.md file with sections: Summary, External findings, Codebase findings, Quality Commands (with Source column), Conflicts surfaced, Concerns. The skill should have dispatched 3-5 parallel teammates and merged their partials. Partials should not exist after merge. Nothing is written to bare .arianna/research.md.
expectations: The agent reads skills/arianna-research/SKILL.md before proceeding
The agent dispatches at least 2 research teammates in a single tool-call batch (parallel, not sequential)
Each teammate has a constrained tool guard (external uses WebSearch, codebase uses Read/Grep — not both)
There is a teammate dedicated to Quality Commands discovery
The agent writes research.md inside the supplied run directory (.arianna/2026-05-11-session-revoke/research.md), NOT bare .arianna/research.md
The research.md inside the run directory has a 'Quality Commands' section with a 'Source' column
The research.md inside the run directory has a 'Conflicts surfaced' section (may be empty but the heading exists)
No leftover .research-*.md partial files remain inside the run directory after merge
The agent returns JSON with phase, teammates_dispatched, research_path, quality_commands_found fields
The research_path field in the returned JSON points inside the supplied run directory (contains '2026-05-11-session-revoke/research.md')
